Task: Hero + vision copy + primary CTAs
Description: Above-the-fold hero that states the problem; Vaultex vision; two clear CTAs (e.g. Browse causes; See transparency).
Detailed prompt: You are a senior React + Tailwind developer on the Vaultex capstone. Replace or extend the homepage hero with: (1) a compelling headline and 2–3 sentences on why transparent donation flow matters; (2) subtext that does not overclaim blockchain guarantees; (3) two primary buttons linking to /causes and /ledger or equivalent; (4) typography and spacing inspired by award portfolio sites—strong hierarchy; minimal gradient; optional subtle motion. Deliver responsive layout and match existing routing. Do not invent fake aggregate donation totals unless labeled as demo or simulated.
Notes / Dependencies: Portfolio-style layout; link to stories + causes

Task: How it works section + trust principles strip
Description: Short 3–4 step strip explaining donate → vault → disburse; plus trust bullets (privacy; verifiability; beneficiary-first).
Detailed prompt: Implement a 'How it works' section below the hero: numbered or icon steps for donor action; vault routing; beneficiary receipt. Add a horizontal or grid 'trust principles' strip (e.g. masked identities; on-chain where applicable; clear limitations). Keep copy short; avoid fake metrics unless explicitly labeled demo. Style with the new glass/light system when ready.
Notes / Dependencies: Short; avoid fake metrics unless labeled demo

Task: Featured beneficiary stories block (cards + link)
Description: Homepage section showing 2–3 featured success stories with image/title teaser and link to full stories hub.
Detailed prompt: Add a 'Impact stories' or 'From beneficiaries' section: fetch featured stories from GET /api/stories?featured=true (or agreed contract with Tasin). Render 2–3 cards with title; excerpt; optional cover image; link to /stories/:id. Loading skeleton; empty state if no stories. Graceful degradation if API not ready—use placeholder copy behind a feature flag if needed.
Notes / Dependencies: Feeds from stories API when ready

Task: Glass morphism system (tokens: blur/border/elevation); reduce gradients
Description: Design tokens for frosted panels; thin borders; soft shadows; single accent color; phase out heavy multi-stop gradients.
Detailed prompt: Define CSS variables or Tailwind @theme tokens for: glass background (semi-transparent + backdrop-blur); border color; shadow levels; radius scale; one accent. Refactor Layout; cards; ledger shell to use tokens. Remove or tone down loud gradients per team direction. Ensure WCAG contrast on glass over photos or dark backgrounds; test prefers-reduced-motion.

Task: Responsive polish + motion (prefers-reduced-motion)
Description: Breakpoints for tables and nav; tap targets; optional subtle transitions respecting reduced motion.
Detailed prompt: Audit key pages at 375px; 768px; 1280px. Fix overflow; stack filters; collapsible nav if needed. Add CSS transitions only where meaningful; wrap non-essential motion in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { * { transition: none } } or equivalent. Document breakpoints in a short comment in index.css or theme file.

Task: Ledger table usability: sticky header + filters UI
Description: Ledger view with sticky column headers and optional filter controls wired to query params or callbacks.
Detailed prompt: Enhance LedgerPage: sticky thead or header row; clear scroll container. Add filter UI (tabs already exist—extend with date range or kind if Tasin adds query support). If no backend filters yet; UI can filter client-side with a TODO for server-side. Ensure keyboard focus order and screen reader labels on filters.
Notes / Dependencies: May pair with Tasin on query params

Task: Global or ledger search bar for transaction hash
Description: Prominent input for 0x-prefixed 66-char tx hash; validate format client-side; navigate to journey page or show inline error.
Detailed prompt: Add a search component (header or ledger top): accept Ethereum tx hash regex; trim whitespace; on submit navigate to /journey/:hash or call preview API. Show inline errors for invalid length or non-hex. Loading state during fetch. Coordinate exact route and API response shape with Tasin.

Task: Life journey page: timeline UI (donor to Vaultex to hospital / held)
Description: New route visualizing donation path: donor → Vaultex → held/disbursed → beneficiary institution with timestamps and masked labels.
Detailed prompt: Create route /journey/:txHash. On mount fetch GET /api/journey/:txHash (or agreed path). Render vertical or horizontal timeline from API steps: each step shows masked entity; status; timestamp; optional tx link to explorer only if course allows. States: loading; not found; partial chain data. Reuse glass card styling. Use masked strings only—never raw addresses for public view.

Task: Consistent masked display + tooltips / glossary
Description: Every wallet display uses same mask pattern as backend; tooltips explain why; optional /glossary or modal for terms.
Detailed prompt: Audit all components showing addresses or hashes. Use one display helper (e.g. maskAddr) aligned with backend rules. Add (i) icon or underline tooltips: 'We mask identities to protect donors and beneficiaries'; (ii) glossary entries for tx hash; vault; disbursement. Ensure admin-only views still respect product decision—if admin sees full addresses document it.

Task: Public list + detail pages (read-only for donors)
Description: Public /stories index and /stories/:id detail for donors and visitors; no edit controls unless role is beneficiary or admin.
Detailed prompt: Implement /stories list: pagination or infinite scroll; card grid from GET /stories. Detail page: title; body; linked cause; proof section read-only. Role check: if user is beneficiary and owns story show 'Edit' link to edit route. Handle 404; loading; SEO-friendly title via document.title optional.

Task: Beneficiary create/edit story UI + proof attachments (URL or upload)
Description: Forms for beneficiaries to create/update stories; attach proof URLs or files per Tasin API contract.
Detailed prompt: Build /stories/new and /stories/:id/edit (protected). Form fields: title; rich text or markdown; cause selector; proofs array (URL inputs or file upload per backend). Submit POST/PATCH with validation messages. Show publish vs draft if backend supports. Respect file size limits and error responses from API.
Notes / Dependencies: Depends on Tasin CRUD + Sukhan storage policy

Task: Empty states + onboarding microcopy
Description: Friendly empty states for ledger; causes; stories; journey not found; first-time donor hints.
Detailed prompt: Replace generic empty views with illustrated or text-first empty states: what happened; what user can do next; link to primary action. Add one short onboarding hint on first visit (localStorage flag) if product agrees—do not nag.

Task: Tx hash resolution + normalized timeline payload
Description: Backend resolves a tx hash into an ordered list of steps combining DB ledger and optional RPC receipt for capstone demo.
Detailed prompt: Implement GET /api/journey/:txHash (under router). Validate hash (0x + 64 hex). Look up ledger_entries and related cause/user labels. Optionally enrich with JsonRpcProvider getTransaction and receipt. Return JSON schema: { steps: [{ phase; label; maskedFrom; maskedTo; status; at; meta }] }. Never return raw addresses to unauthenticated clients unless explicitly admin—use existing mask helpers. Handle 404 gracefully.
Notes / Dependencies: Merge DB ledger + RPC where needed

Task: Public search endpoint: validate hash + rate limit
Description: Same journey endpoint or dedicated POST /api/journey/search with throttling to prevent abuse.
Detailed prompt: Add rate limiting (e.g. express-rate-limit per IP) on journey lookup routes. Normalize input; reject malformed hashes with 400. Log minimal info without PII. Document limits in README for Haha to show errors.

Task: Ensure all ledger list responses use masking helper
Description: Audit every endpoint returning from_addr; to_addr; or user addresses; apply consistent masking for non-admin public responses.
Detailed prompt: Grep app.ts for res.json patterns. Centralize maskAddr or equivalent for public routes. Add unit or integration test asserting anonymous GET /ledger never contains full 0x addresses. Admin routes: decide policy; if full addresses for admin document and test.

Task: Optional ledger filters (date range / cause / kind) query support
Description: Query params ?from=&to=&causeId=&kind= on GET /ledger with validated SQL filters.
Detailed prompt: Extend GET /ledger to accept optional filters; validate dates ISO; bind parameters only—no string concat SQL. Return same shape as today. Update README query param table for frontend.

Task: DB schema + migrations for stories + proofs
Description: SQLite tables stories and story_proofs with beneficiary user_id FK; timestamps; optional published flag.
Detailed prompt: Add migration or startup migration block in db.ts: stories (id; user_id; title; body; cause_id nullable; status; created_at; updated_at); story_proofs (id; story_id; type url|file; url text; sort_order). Indexes on user_id and published. Seed optional demo row if empty flag.

Task: REST: GET public; POST/PATCH beneficiary; optional admin moderation
Description: CRUD with auth: list public published; beneficiary CRUD own; admin optional approve/delete.
Detailed prompt: Mount routes GET /api/stories; GET /api/stories/:id; POST /api/stories; PATCH /api/stories/:id; DELETE optional. Enforce requireAuth; compare req.session user id to story.user_id for mutations. Return 403 on violation. Sanitize HTML in body if accepting rich text.

Task: Proof validation (URL SSRF/size; or upload handshake)
Description: Validate proof URLs (https only; block localhost/metadata IPs); max lengths; optional signed upload URL flow.
Detailed prompt: If URL-only: validate protocol; length; optional SSRF guard using URL parser and denylist private ranges. If upload: integrate presigned URL pattern per Sukhan decision; max size; content-type allowlist. Return clear 400 errors.
Notes / Dependencies: Sukhan decides upload vs URL-only MVP

Task: Harden cookies/sessions for prod config notes
Description: Document and implement secure cookie flags when NODE_ENV=production and HTTPS is assumed.
Detailed prompt: cookie-session: set secure true in prod; sameSite strict or lax per deployment; SESSION_SECRET required in prod (fail fast if missing). Add .env.example entries. Short comment in app.ts.

Task: Throttle login/register + consistent error payloads
Description: Rate limit auth routes; generic error message for wrong password to prevent enumeration where acceptable.
Detailed prompt: Apply express-rate-limit to /api/auth/login and register. Standardize { error: string } shape. Consider constant-time compare already bcrypt—document.

Task: Structured logging + readiness (DB optional RPC ping)
Description: JSON or prefixed logs for errors; GET /ready checks DB and optionally RPC for orchestrators.
Detailed prompt: Add /ready returning 200 only if db pragma succeeds and optionally provider.getBlockNumber once. Avoid logging secrets or full session. Use for Docker healthchecks later.

Task: API tests: journey permission + masking + story CRUD roles
Description: Minimal vitest or supertest suite for critical API contracts.
Detailed prompt: Add test runner; spin in-memory sqlite or test file; assert journey 404; ledger masking; story PATCH forbidden for wrong user.

Task: foundry.toml + src layout + deployment script to Anvil
Description: Foundry project under blockchain/ with Valutex or vault contract; script deploys to local Anvil; outputs addresses.
Detailed prompt: Initialize or fix Foundry layout: foundry.toml; src/ValutexVault.sol (or project name); script/Deploy.s.sol. forge build; forge script --rpc-url $ANVIL_RPC --broadcast. Document deployed addresses in .env.example for backend ANVIL_CONTRACT_* or similar. Pin Solidity pragma consistent with OZ version.

Task: Persist / reproduce Anvil: state snapshot + documented reset flow
Description: Document how to save and restore Anvil state for repeatable capstone demos and grading.
Detailed prompt: Research anvil --dump-state / --load-state or equivalent Foundry flags. Add scripts/demo-save.sh and demo-restore.sh or Windows equivalents. README section: cold start vs restored state; deterministic accounts.

Task: Wire backend to deployed contract addresses (env + README)
Description: Environment variables for vault token or vault contract; Tasin reads in watcher and donate flows if applicable.
Detailed prompt: After deploy script; list env vars ANVIL_RPC_URL; CONTRACT_VAULT; etc. Update backend to use env when present. README table of all env vars. Coordinate with Tasin on any new config keys.

Task: Optional: anchor story hash / daily summary on-chain
Description: Light contract or log line storing keccak256 of story bundle for audit narrative.
Detailed prompt: If time: minimal contract with storeHash(bytes32) event; script to anchor; backend optional job to post hash when story published. Document cost and limitation on Anvil.

Task: Written privacy & masking policy (README or one-pager)
Description: Single source of truth for what is public; masked; admin-only; and ethical use of beneficiary stories.
Detailed prompt: Write docs/PRIVACY.md or README section: data collected; retention; masking rules; beneficiary consent for public stories; limitations of on-chain privacy. Align wording with actual Haha+Tasin behavior.

Task: 7-minute demo script + slide outline
Description: Scripted demo with slide titles; who speaks; backup path if chain offline.
Detailed prompt: Produce markdown doc: minute-by-minute actions on screen; one backup video or screenshots; Q&A anticipated questions. Assign Haha UI moments vs Tasin API vs Sukhan chain narrative.

Task: User testing mini-study (5+ sessions) + findings table
Description: Lightweight usability sessions with task list and results table.
Detailed prompt: Recruit 5+ participants; tasks: find a cause; check ledger; search journey; read story. Record completion; errors; SUS optional. Summarize themes and what changed in product.

Task: Comparative analysis (2-3 platforms/papers) + citations
Description: Short lit review comparing Vaultex approach to existing donation transparency tools or papers.
Detailed prompt: 2–3 paragraphs each with citations (URLs or DOI). Table comparing dimensions: transparency model; privacy; beneficiary agency; crypto use.

Task: Architecture diagram + sequence: donate / disburse / watch
Description: Mermaid or exported diagram in README for donate; disburse; chain watcher.
Detailed prompt: Add README section with mermaid sequenceDiagram for user donate; admin disburse; watcher ingest. Optional C4-style context diagram.

Task: README: setup + env + demo troubleshooting
Description: Expand README with workspaces; env vars; Anvil; common failures.
Detailed prompt: Ensure npm run dev; ports; ANVIL; SESSION_SECRET; Windows notes; Docker optional. Troubleshooting: ECONNREFUSED; better-sqlite3 build; CORS.

Task: Docker Compose (optional): web + api + anvil + seed state
Description: One-command compose for evaluators with correct Anvil host binding and healthchecks.
Detailed prompt: Dockerfile(s) for frontend nginx + backend node; compose services; fix Foundry image ENTRYPOINT sh -c for anvil --host 0.0.0.0; volumes for sqlite; document docker compose up.

Task: Playwright smoke: login + journey + story view
Description: Automated smoke tests against local dev or CI.
Detailed prompt: Playwright config; tests: login seeded user; open ledger; open journey if hash seeded; open stories list. Run in CI optional.

Task: Weekly sync: unblock dependencies + update this sheet
Description: Process: standup; update Status; flag Blocked owners.
Detailed prompt: Use this CSV in Excel; update Status weekly; link PRs in Notes column; resolve dependency order P0 journey backend before FE polish if needed.
